update.jetzt.hinweis: The update is downloaded and checked. Then the app closes, the update is installed and the app starts again.
update.nur_windows: On this system the app cannot install updates by itself yet.
update.bereit: Version {version} has been checked and is being installed.
update.startet: The update is being installed. The app will start again afterwards.
update.offline: No connection. We will try again later.
update.quelle: The update source is not reachable right now.
update.unsicher: This update does not reliably come from Daedyx and was not installed.
update.von_hand: This version cannot check the new update. Please download the new version by hand, expected source: {quelle}.
update.zurueck: The update source offers an older version than before. Please report this.
update.kein_platz: Not enough disk space for the update.
update.datei: The update could not be stored in the data folder.
update.nicht_gesichert: Your last change could not be saved. The update was not started.
update.start_fehler: The update could not be started. Please try again.
update.auto.hinweis: At most once a day. Nothing is installed without your click.
